    Proposition 6.5(3): regular lifts at projective labels #

    positive-deformations.tex: "If M_i = e_xΛ for a primitive idempotent e_x of Λ₀, we may choose M_i^B = e_xB for a lift e_x ∈ B of that idempotent. […] At a projective label, the actual regular module e_xB has the required associated grading."

    We give eΛ (e of degree zero) its graded right module structure (rightIdeal), and show that the regular module e B, identified with eΛ through a splitting φ multiplicative on the left by e (Lemma 6.4), is a filtered lift of eΛ (regularLift). By the uniqueness of Proposition 6.5(1) it is then isomorphic to any other filtered lift.
